---
title: "Exercises"
---

Hands-on tutorials for the workshop. Each one is a downloadable `.qmd` file with code, *Think about it* prompts, and collapsible answers --- open it in RStudio, point the data paths at your local copy of the dataset (see [Datasets](Datasets.qmd)), and run it chunk by chunk.

## Reading order

The seven core tutorials build on each other --- complete them in order. The DESeq2 primer (Tutorial 04 Primer) is recommended before Tutorial 04 if you've never used DESeq2 before.

| # | Time | Prerequisites | What you'll have at the end |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | \~60 min | [Setup](Setup.qmd) complete | A QC'd, normalized Seurat object with HVGs |
| 02 | \~45 min | Tutorial 01 | A clustered UMAP embedding |
| 03 | \~45 min | Tutorial 02 | Cluster-marker tables and tentative cell-type labels |
| 04 Primer | \~30 min | None (uses `airway` Bioconductor data) | A working DESeq2 result on bulk RNA-seq |
| 04 | \~45 min | Tutorial 03 + 04 Primer | Cell-type-resolved DE results from `DESeq2` |
| 05 | \~30 min | Tutorial 03 | Reference-mapped annotations from `SingleR` and Azimuth |
| 06 | \~60 min | Tutorial 02 | A clustered scATAC object with gene-activity-based labels |
| 07 | \~60 min | None (uses GEO bulk RNA-seq) | A WGCNA module–trait heatmap on COVID-19 PBMC data |

## Datasets used

Full dataset descriptions, direct download links, and a disk-space budget live on the [Datasets](Datasets.qmd) page. Primary sources:

-   **scRNA-seq** --- [10x Genomics: 20k NSCLC DTC, 3' v3.1 Multiplex](https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets/20-k-mixture-of-nsclc-dt-cs-from-7-donors-3-v-3-1-multiplex-3-1-standard-6-0-0)
-   **DESeq2 primer** --- `airway` Bioconductor package (no manual download)
-   **scATAC-seq** --- [10x Genomics: PBMC 10k scATAC-seq v1](https://www.10xgenomics.com/resources/datasets/10-k-peripheral-blood-mononuclear-cells-pbm-cs-from-a-healthy-donor-1-standard-1-1-0) (matches Patel's tutorial)
-   **WGCNA** --- [GEO: GSE152418 (COVID-19 PBMC bulk RNA-seq)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE152418)

By convention the tutorials read from `../data/` (i.e. a `data/` folder at the repository root). Place your downloads there or adjust the paths in the `Read10X*` calls.

## Adapted from

Tutorials 04 (Primer), 06 (scATAC), and 07 (WGCNA) follow the worked examples in [Khushbu Patel's YouTube Tutorials repo](https://github.com/kpatel427/YouTubeTutorials), with workshop-specific commentary and call-out boxes.
